## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Azerbaijani-language 3D FPS game named “Qarabağ,” with snowy villages, enemies, capture objectives, weapons, vehicles, and sound effects.
- The user also requested an Azerbaijani flag game icon and Play Store publication.

## Requirements
- Include forward/backward movement, crouching, sprinting, jumping, reloading, and FPS view.
- Include AK-74 and AK-47 weapons, human-shaped brown-camouflage enemies, ruined snowy villages, Katyusha and Sandcat vehicles, gunfire and footsteps audio.
- Occupied houses display Armenian flags; capturing them raises Azerbaijani flags.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser-based Three.js game with procedural geometry and synthesized audio; no external model assets.
- Desktop controls use WASD, Shift, C/Ctrl, Space, R, 1/2, and mouse; touch controls are included.
- Play Store publication is not complete; no Android packaging, signing, or store submission exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, `game.js`, and `flag.svg` with game UI, six capture objectives, snowy terrain, houses, enemies, vehicles, weapons, audio, mobile controls, and game states.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Static server responds at `http://localhost:3000`; Chromium was installed after the initial browser launch failure.

### Active
- Validate runtime/browser gameplay and repair any issues found; no screenshot or gameplay test has yet been completed.
- Verify objective capture, flag ownership changes, enemy targeting, and desktop/mobile controls.

### Blocked
- Play Store publication remains outstanding and requires Android packaging, signing, and developer account/submission access.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3000` with `playwright-cli` and test the rendered game; save and inspect a screenshot.
2. Play-test capture progression, flag transitions, combat, movement, and mobile layout; fix any issues.
3. Report the game state and clarify that Play Store submission remains outstanding.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, controls, combat, enemy AI, capture, and audio.
- `index.html`: Game UI and Azerbaijani text.
- `style.css`: Desktop/mobile styling and HUD.
- `flag.svg`: Azerbaijani flag favicon.
- `start.sh`: Starts the static server.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Server is reachable at `http://localhost:3000`; `localhost:3002` was the wrong port for this static server.
- Browser installation resolved the earlier Chromium-missing blocker, but browser validation has not yet been performed.
